'''Piglin Guards''' are [[NPCs]] that appear throughout the {{Zone|Crimson Isle}}, either in the {{Zone|Chief's Hut}} during the [[Barbarian Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]], {{Zone|The Bastion}} during the [[Mage Faction]] questline, or in {{Zone|The Wasteland}} at the end of both questlines.

== Quests ==
During the [[Barbarian Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]], two '''Piglin Guards''' briefly appear in the {{Zone|Chief's Hut}} on three separate occasions: once when {{NPCSprite|Chief Scorn}} kicks out {{NPCSprite|Ugo}} and {{NPCSprite|Elle}} after the player joins the faction, again when they also get kicked out after discussing stolen research, and at the end when just {{NPCSprite|Ugo}} is kicked out.

During the [[Mage Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]], two '''Piglin Guards''' appear in {{Zone|The Bastion}}, when the player is instructed to steal research from there. After the research has been stolen, they disappear, along with the other [[Guard]]s.

Two '''Piglin Guards''' also appear in {{Zone|The Wasteland}} when the two [[Factions]] meet each other at the end of either [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]].
